_about: The ten jobs, measured 7 Nov 2026 22:10 to 22:20 UTC against the running dashboard (127.0.0.1:5173, live mock engine, Worker view, 1440x900) by docs/knack-ux/scripts/measure-jobs.mjs. 'current_clicks' counts clicks from the app being open and showing its landing screen. A click on a destructive control is counted and NOT executed. 'from_menu_bar' counts the desktop path today (the dashboard is a browser tab opened by the menu bar, and the menu bar only opens it at the Today screen). 'target_clicks' is the budget the build must meet; scripts/check-clicks.mjs (to be written by SHELL-WEB) replays 'target_path' and fails above budget. Depth = clicks from Home.
